sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2025/05/PXD053250/txt.7z (HTTP range read of header and first 16 MB; member 'txt/2023-11 AD+A7 list samples DDA - MaxQuant.xlsx')

claims.location: comment[data file] / source name / assay name
claims.evidence: filePaths and experiments in mqpar.xml (138 entries, identical to Intensity columns of the deposited proteinGroups table). The RAW archive LC_MS_file.7z (330.8 GB) is truncated relative to its own header (header points past EOF) so its member list could not be read; file names come from mqpar.xml.

claims.value: mouse <numeric animal ID>; 8 IDs occur twice
claims.evidence: Leading number of the run name taken as animal ID (our inference). 35033, 38319, 44998, 34243, 35967, 37201, 19786 occur twice (S1 and S2/G slots) and are treated as technical replicate 2 of the same source.
PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; UniProt mouse FASTA in mqpar.
Protocol: brain tissue homogenate; PRIDE organism part brain.
Paper: APPPS1 and APPPS1-hA7ko Alzheimer mouse model cohorts. Genotype per run is not deposited, so the factor value mirrors the disease column only to satisfy the template (not a real comparison).
Paper gives group sizes (n=8 male/7 female hA7ko; 7/7 APPPS1) and 50-200 days but no per-run mapping; run-name prefixes f/m on 86 of 138 runs are not documented.
Protocol text: timsTOF pro2 with Evosep One; PRIDE dropdown says timsTOF Pro (text preferred).
Protocol: DDA PASEF; mqpar lcmsRunType TIMS-DDA.
Trypsin 1:50 overnight; mqpar enzyme Trypsin/P, i.e. no proline restriction, as the protocol states.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (C) fixed; Oxidation (M), Acetyl (Protein N-term) variable
claims.evidence: mqpar.xml fixedModifications/variableModifications. Protocol also mentions carbamyl (N-term) variable, absent from mqpar, so omitted.
mainSearchTol 10 ppm in mqpar (protocol prose says 4.5 ppm, the post-recalibration figure).
Inferred: PASEF on timsTOF uses collision cell CID; not stated explicitly.

limitations: RAW archive header unreadable (truncated 7z), so .d names are from mqpar.xml and not verified against archive members.
No per-run genotype, sex or age mapping in the deposit; those are not available.
Animal ID is inferred from run names; deposit has 130 IDs while the paper analyses 29 mice, so the deposit appears to cover more cohorts than the paper.
